article_appliance_symbols.summary: Washing machines, dishwashers and ovens are labelled in pictures so they can be used in any country. After reading this you can name the common symbols, choose the right programme and temperature, understand the salt, detergent and rinse aid symbols, and work a machine you have never used before.
article_appliance_symbols.title: Understanding Household Appliance Symbols

article_kids_animals_ocean.summary: The ocean covers most of our planet, and every part of it is full of life. After reading this you can name the animals that live in each zone of the sea, use the words scientists use for them, and stay safe when you visit the beach.
article_kids_animals_ocean.title: Life Under the Ocean
